title: Data of a health event (stream health, v1.0)
description: The same fields as in status.get, from the same code. One event is built per period and the same bytes, with the same (epoch, seq), go to every transport subscribed; a gap in seq on one transport is an event dropped there.

battery_level.description: The level from the mean of 60 s of battery readings (since v0.3.12). unknown while no valid reading can be had; never critical for a missing or invalid reading. The observed level, not a state of charge.

battery_level_changes.description: Changes of battery_level since boot, the first reading included; wraps at 65536 (since v0.3.12).

power_source.description: external or battery only on a board that senses USB power; unknown otherwise (since v0.3.12).

battery_guard.description: The battery guard (since v0.3.12). enabled: the stored setting. supported: whether this board is in the support matrix. effective: report-only where the build has no protective sleep; where it has one (not yet in a release: the Heltec V3 and V4 Companion and Repeater), what the guard does now, and the members after it, null while the guard keeps no state.

test_offset_mv.description: A bench build only: the offset the guard takes off each reading.

contacts.description: Absent on a role with no contact list.
